Sandbox_ServerGuide_AutoOpen_tooltip: If enabled, the guide opens automatically when a player joins (players can still opt out individually if allowed below). If disabled, it never opens on join -- players only open it from the pause menu (Esc). Default: enabled
Sandbox_ServerGuide_AllowOptOut_tooltip: If enabled, each player gets a checkbox to turn off the auto-open for themselves. If disabled, the checkbox is hidden and the guide always auto-opens on join (only applies when auto-open above is enabled). Default: enabled
Sandbox_ServerGuide_EditAccessLevels_too: Which access levels may edit guides and the menu in-game, separated by ";" (e.g. admin;moderator;overseer;gm). Leave empty to allow none. The host (SP/co-op) can always edit. Default: admin;moderator;overseer;gm
